name: Nev, the Practical Dean
oracle_text:
Creatures you control with counters on them have trample.
Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, put X +1/+1 counters on Nev.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, put X +1/+1 counters on Nev.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key that matches a spell whose printed mana cost contains {X} (the selector-side `x_in_mana_cost: true`), honoured by the trigger matcher so `nth: 1` counts only X spells for "your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `mana_cost`, but that is an exact printed-cost match (has_printed_cost), so it cannot say 'any cost containing {X}'. `x_in_mana_cost` is a selector key only; `validate_trigger_filter` refuses it because TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS does not include it and the trigger matcher never reads it
